objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless item whose content and properties are created, edited, released, distributed, archived, translated, revised, invalidated, or reactivated.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding type selected when creating a new document; examples include policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document; type abbreviations are listed for common document types and are the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to relevant companies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to areas of validity.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document; documents are managed in versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document; documents have statuses in a status network and workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute identifying the author with personal authorization; the creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute identifying reviewers for document review and authorization.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute identifying releasers for document release and authorization.

attributes.name: translation_releaser
attributes.description: Releaser attribute including translation, used in authorizations and reactivation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted; updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary; defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for archiving defined for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects email notification for existing groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects workflow task distribution for existing groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Original language version referenced for translation; translated content requires the original language version to be released.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which authorized readers see released language versions.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type that documents regulations and instructions; locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type for special detailed work steps in sub-processes, often relevant for few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to create new documents or added to documents as additional information or attachment.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure cover object to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office formats used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document; automatically released with the main document and affects the associated version.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Attachments are subject to their own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Attachments pass through all statuses of the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Attachments have the same validity as the main document when released with validity extension.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional information object added to a document, not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment/additional equipment or information referenced as being added to documents and reactivated with documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user/person who can have roles, authorizations, workflow tasks, acknowledgements, and distribution assignments.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned personal authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for assigning authorizations, reader access, roles, and distribution.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Named group such as Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, releaser, Archive, Business Admin group.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents to assign read and change rights to users/persons.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System or license role implemented to provide users with functions according to area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Group and person-related authorization assigned in document properties.

attributes.name: read_right
attributes.description: Right allowing users or groups to view documents.

attributes.name: change_right
attributes.description: Right allowing users or persons to change documents.

attributes.name: write_access
attributes.description: Access allowing users to create requests or modify documents.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role/user who can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: System role for users offered in author or co-author selection lists and assigned read/write permissions.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person or role checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: Releaser responsible for document and content, deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User who can translate released content into another language and cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: User/person who creates a document, proposal, or request and may be initiator/editor of a workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User/person with additional personal change rights but no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User/person responsible for release or approval.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document, created and managed for a document.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Change proposals may be completed and then no longer displayed in the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate or override a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Creator of the request for reactivation.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported processing structure for approval, release, validity extension, override, acknowledgement, and translation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow status displayed in reports and notifications.

attributes.name: last_status_change
attributes.description: Date or time used in traffic light evaluation of documents in workflow.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants, acknowledged or completed with signature depending on process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Task status used for acknowledgements and workflow processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Individual participant signature documented in the system and printable as document content.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document, including released, editing, invalidated, translated or reactivated versions.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Number changed on new versions and after reactivation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status such as released, editing, out of force, invalidated.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Validity start date for the version.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Validity end date for the version.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document visible to authorized readers in corresponding login language after release.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the translated version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Language version must be released before visibility to authorized readers.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document containing user groups and persons for distribution, dashboard assignment, email notification, and acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: Distribution type where assigned users and group users are informed by email when a new version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type requiring recipients to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation that a user has taken note of a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Acknowledgement status listed in reports and overviews.

attributes.name: confirmed
attributes.description: Whether acknowledgement has been confirmed.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Email used to inform users of workflow tasks, change proposals, releases, validity extension, override, and acknowledgement requests.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled based on distribution groups and displaying relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents and instructions.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter influencing evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion filtering result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light_status
attributes.description: Traffic light display status used in reports.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Object evaluated in status reports together with additional information.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process object to which documents can be automatically linked or for which filing can be process-specific.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company attribute/object used in document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained via document properties.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: Whether a corresponding document is visible in the client.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Document properties, attributes, metadata, authorizations, workflow participants, and distribution attributes are maintained.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with the editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: The document is saved after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF and displayed on the web.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover is created for file upload or document generation.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents are uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents are generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted directly.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The three-step release process is initiated after document creation and maintenance.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete assigned workflow tasks.

evts.name: sign_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document.

evts.name: reject_workflow_step
evts.description: A review or release step is rejected, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: A new editing version is automatically created when a valid released document is revised or when attachment changes trigger a new version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights employee creates a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of the assigned change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is completed and no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system creates a validity extension request before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared and the valid until date is updated.

evts.name: delete_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The validity extension request is deleted after validity extension or new version release.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: A user with write access creates an AKS request for a selected document.

evts.name: process_aks_request
evts.description: The AKS request workflow is processed by releaser or by initiator, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: The document and attachments are declared invalid/out of force and archived.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: All rights except archive group rights are revoked for archived documents.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A business admin group member creates a reactivation request and selects the corresponding document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is revalidated by creating a new version and restoring maintained properties.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Equippments archived with the document are reactivated during document reactivation.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups and persons are maintained on the document distribution list.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Users receive email notifications for workflow tasks, proposals, releases, validity extension, override, and acknowledgement requests.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users in assigned groups are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Dashboards are filled based on distribution groups maintained per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Role-specific reports evaluate documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status based on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_language_version
evts.description: A translated language version is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For a document in a multi-client system, visible clients are specified.
